title: Markup
description: The UI of a mark-up tool, after Claude Code's browser-pane markup bar. It catches clicks for the two tools that work on the page (select picks elements, comment places a comment) and hands you what they give; what a picked element means, what the pen and shapes draw, the undo history, and saving each mark and comment as it is made (there is no send-all) are the app's. Parts: Markup (the state: bind:tool select | comment | pen | shape | null, bind:shape line | arrow | rectangle | ellipse | step, bind:colour, bind:width), MarkupBar (the floating surface; no key in it or its menus reaches the page; Escape is a ladder: an open menu closes, else the newest open comment, else the tool is put down), MarkupTools (bits-ui Toolbar: one tab stop, arrows move), MarkupTool (a toggle; the tool in hand is the copper key; aria-label shown as a tooltip), MarkupShapes and MarkupShape (the shape tool with a chevron menu of kinds, icon and name), MarkupSeparator, MarkupColors (a menu of your ColorPickerSwatch), MarkupWidths and MarkupWidth (a menu of lines), MarkupAction (undo, redo, delete: a ghost icon Button with a tooltip), MarkupClose, MarkupLayer (the layer select and comment work on: bind:selected elements, each kept outlined with its tag; onPlace({ element, at }) for a comment; root, label), MarkupHighlight (an element's outline and tag, following it by anchor, or at a rect), MarkupSelection (eight handles on a selected mark's box; onHold(handle, event)), MarkupComment (bind:open, bind:value, onSend(text), onOpenChange), MarkupCommentPin (a 24px numbered circle at a spot, anchor and at, following its element; variant done for a check), MarkupCommentBox (a growing field with its send button inside, floating from the pin's corner with Floating UI; the corner it grew from is pointed; Enter sends) and MarkupCommentSend. No copy inside: every label is yours.
